fld-tro.label: LSG run outs per bowling innings
fld-tro.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fld-tro.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (13) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, COUNT(DISTINCT i.innings_id) inns, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.kind = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ro, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.kind IN ('caught','caught and bowled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ct, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.kind = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) st, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 1 OR d.is_noball = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) wnb, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) byes FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 GROUP BY side
